fee_notes: Base fee for territory with 12,500-15,000 businesses. Additional $5,000 per 1,000 businesses over 15,000. $7,500 discount for additional franchises purchased within 24 months. Up to $5,000 veterans discount. Winners' Circle rebate program available.
raw_excerpt: You must pay an initial franchise fee of $39,900 for a territory with between 12,500 and 15,000 businesses in it. If the number of businesses in your territory exceeds 15,000, then you must pay an additional $5,000 for all or part of every 1,000 businesses in excess of 15,000.
